main.description: Apply a batch of creates, updates, and deletes in one boundary as a single commit. Mirrors com.atproto.space.applyWrites at atproto commit 98ef3a6b9, addressing the boundary by its service-qualified name. Requires auth.

repo.description: The DID of the repo to write to (the authenticated member).

validate.description: Can be set to 'false' to skip Lexicon schema validation of record data across all operations, 'true' to require it, or leave unset to validate only for known Lexicons.

writes.description: The writes to apply. One batch is one commit, so the length is bounded to the limit the reference implementation enforces; the server rejects larger batches before charging the rate limit.

errors.name: RecordNotFound
errors.description: An update or delete targeted a record that does not exist.

errors.name: RecordAlreadyExists
errors.description: A create targeted a collection and rkey that already holds a record.

errors.name: BoundaryMismatch
errors.description: The record carries a boundary that differs from the boundary parameter.

errors.name: InvalidRecord
errors.description: The record is not an object, its $type is missing or differs from the collection, or it breaks a content rule of the collection.

errors.name: InvalidCollection
errors.description: The collection is not allowed in this boundary.

errors.name: NotEnrolled
errors.description: The caller is not enrolled, or the enrollment is inactive.

errors.name: PdsCustodyWriteForbidden
errors.description: The caller keeps their records on their own PDS and cannot write here.

errors.name: ForbiddenBoundary
errors.description: The caller does not hold this boundary.

errors.name: ServiceMismatch
errors.description: The boundary belongs to another service.

errors.name: RateLimitExceeded
errors.description: The caller has exceeded the write rate limit.

errors.name: ScopeUpgradeRequired
errors.description: The member's grant predates this collection. Authorize again.

create.description: Operation which creates a new record.

update.description: Operation which updates an existing record.

delete.description: Operation which deletes an existing record.
